steps.title: Configure SDK Targets
steps.description: Set up standard SDK tools targeting compileSdkVersion 34 and targetSdkVersion 34 with Java 17 toolchain settings.

steps.title: Create Application Manifest
steps.description: Establish AndroidManifest.xml containing the Internet permission, Main launcher activity configuration, and system material light theme application.

steps.title: Define Metadata and Backend Schemas
steps.description: Configure the core app identification keys, base URLs, and descriptive verification logic endpoints.

steps.title: Implement Native Backend API Handler
steps.description: Develop BackendApi.java supporting registration, login, logout, session state storage, and dynamic authorization token attachments.

steps.title: Build Application XML Interface Layout
steps.description: Construct standard XML hierarchy representing the dynamic Login view container, Register view container, and Calculator dashboard components.

steps.title: Design Interactive Controller Framework
steps.description: Create MainActivity.java controlling system state changes and binding UI handlers for all interactive buttons and spinners.

steps.title: Implement Registration Actions and Checks
steps.description: Add registration data validation logic ensuring passwords match, fields are non-empty, and auto-logs in with new user keys.

steps.title: Implement Local Arithmetic Calculations
steps.description: Program deterministic, precision-safe Java arithmetic calculations for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and safe division controls.

steps.title: Incorporate authoritative Verification Actions
steps.description: Implement HTTP connection handlers matching the local calculation data structure against independent Cloudflare verifications.

steps.title: Verify Local Error and Connection Handling
steps.description: Conduct structural integration verification checks on HTTP stream error parsing, empty numerical parameters, and session invalidations.

steps.title: Execute Final Asset Alignment
steps.description: Ensure package identification lines and Gradle dependency scopes are aligned properly before production compilation.

steps.title: Building Calculator Verifier Test
steps.description: Compile the complete verified project via gradle build tools compiling classes to direct native architecture assets.
